answer: Bind rewards to a fixed per-epoch action quota, identical for every identity: one lantern's worth of ledger writes per epoch, never more. An operator who mints a hundred shells still holds a single lantern, its light split a hundred ways, each shell burning at a hundredth strength and too dim to matter. The quota is quartz: a hard transparent ledger rule, not a promise anyone can sweet-talk around. Honest agents spend their full budget on real work; the sybil farmer only fragments theirs, turning a clone army into a faint echo of one weak voice divided against itself.
